AssistantTurnIn.description:
v1 `AssistantRequest`, minus the per-request LLM overrides (the instance's LLM
is the admin's setting).
AssistantTurnIn.title: AssistantTurnIn

Collection.description:
«Карта коллекции» (v1 `DistributionsPanel`): what the library is made of — not what
is played. v1's definitions: top 5 genres, its six IQR duration buckets (commonest
first), top 5 artists by tracks, formats by file extension with the lossless share.
Collection.title: Collection

DiscoveriesOut.description:
The assistant page's «связи в библиотеке» rail — v1's cards (each a turn to
send), with the tracks they name as v2 TrackOut.
DiscoveriesOut.title: DiscoveriesOut

Gain.description: dB to reach −14 LUFS; a boost never goes past −1 dBTP.
Gain.title: Gain

InstanceOut.description: Open: what a client needs before sign-in.
InstanceOut.title: InstanceOut

ItemMove.description:
Either the client's key (offline replay) or the neighbour to land after
(`afterItemId` None = the top).
ItemMove.title: ItemMove

ItemsAdd.description: Placed after `afterItemId` (None: at the end), or at the client's own positions.
ItemsAdd.title: ItemsAdd

MemberOut.description: One account as the owner sees it: counts only, never another account's titles.
MemberOut.title: MemberOut

ReasonOut.description: «Почему этот трек»: a chip (`text`) and the detail sheet (`details`).
ReasonOut.title: ReasonOut

RoundOut.description:
The question — never the track or the correct option. `audioUrl` (and each
option's `audioUrl`) is signed and lives as long as the round.
RoundOut.title: RoundOut

SignalData.description: Clients compute the «заряд» locally: 0.5 ** (age_days / 1), locked above 0.5.
SignalData.title: SignalData

TasteMapOut.description:
«Сонар вкуса», computed nightly; empty until the first run or under 8 tracks.
Points are parallel lists (x, y in ~[-1, 1]; cluster indexes `clusters`).
TasteMapOut.title: TasteMapOut

TopHit.description: One mixed, best-first catalog list (songs, albums and artists ranked together).
TopHit.title: TopHit

TrackChatIn.description: v1 `TrackChatRequest`: the drawer chat about one track, or «explain this line».
TrackChatIn.title: TrackChatIn

TrackKnowledge.description:
Everything the player shows about a track. Refined facts win per subject; a subject
facts_v2 has seen but kept nothing of is [] (a real answer, not «not yet»).
TrackKnowledge.title: TrackKnowledge

TurnOut.description:
`result` is v1's payload shape (AssistantResponse / TrackChatResponse); every
track id it names is also in `tracks` as a v2 TrackOut, images in `images`.
TurnOut.title: TurnOut

VibeOut.description: A «вайбик»: tapping it plays /stream/autoplay seeded by the first track.
VibeOut.title: VibeOut

WeeklyPulse.description: This local week (Monday..now): time listened, top genre, first-ever listens.
WeeklyPulse.title: WeeklyPulse

v1 kept this for the client to free a turn context early; v2 contexts live a
minute in the ai worker and expire on their own — the call is accepted as a no-op.

Hook cards: sample links with both sides in the library, recurring producers,
artists with a bio. Empty when there is nothing verifiable to show.

post.description:
One message to the assistant. Progress: `assistant.stage` over the WebSocket;
then `assistant.done`, and the result is `GET /assistant/turns/{turnId}`.
Native clients send `refreshToken`; the web sends no body and its cookie is read.

get.description:
The energy envelope the players draw the spectrum wave from (phase 4 spec §4):
zlib of uint8 frames × 4 bands, 10 frames/s (contexts/intel/envelope). Immutable per
media file, so it is cached for a year under the file's sha.
Facts (song and artist), producers, labels, samples and the vibe line.
